correctness.rationale: Solving the printed equilibrium equations exactly gives y=-fx, z=b+cf=856/25, x=(b+cf)/(a(f+1))=428/1445, y=-5136/7225 and w=(fx^2+dz)/e=1432077728/18792225. Exact substitution vanishes. Expanding det(lambda I-J) at this point gives the primitive positive-coefficient quartic printed in the package. The nontrivial Routh–Hurwitz determinants recompute exactly as Delta_2=1850867402738339250 and Delta_3=23033184284619159659128251000, both positive; therefore every eigenvalue has negative real part. The approximate roots are consistent but unnecessary.
